_doc: Generated-only replacement placement spec. Heading anchors were retained from the original reviewed placement file.

figures.alt: Kitchen cabinet run checked level and aligned before countertop installation
figures.caption: Find studs, establish a level reference, and secure the boxes in sequence. Countertops and doors depend on the cabinet run being straight, plumb, and properly supported.

figures.alt: Kitchen sink base cabinet with supply valves, drain, and service access
figures.caption: Coordinate sink, drain, water, and appliance connections before the final cabinet faces are locked in. The sink base needs access as well as a clean exterior alignment.

figures.alt: Undermount kitchen sink hardware secured beneath a countertop opening
figures.caption: Verify countertop and sink requirements before final fastening. Cabinet installation should leave the supports and clearances needed for the finished sink assembly.
